Quotes, charts and headlines use the already-permitted Yahoo Finance service. No app messages or group names are sent. News pages open outside SilentPulse in your browser, where Yahoo and publisher privacy policies, cookies and tracking may apply. No article pages or images are loaded inside the app. Longer-range chart colors describe that range; the price-change text always compares with the previous trading close.
